newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian family confidence index climbs in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Italian family confidence index climbs in Dec.

text.p: Confidence among Italian households rose month-on-month in December, while the outlook for 1997 was also improving, economic research group Isco said in a survey.
Isco's confidence index (1980=100) climbed to 105.3 this month from 102.7 in November but was below 108.4 in December 1995.
It was the first monthly increase since August.
Isco said its survey showed families were expecting a slowdown in price rises while worries about unemployment remained unchanged.

Looking to the next 12 months, people were expecting to spend a bit more on durable goods than they had indicated in November, as well as on home improvements. More families also said they might buy a house over the next two years.
But Isco said it saw no increase in the number of people planning to buy a car. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
